name: Dicebox d21-d29 regular silhouette set
coordinateSystem: right-handed, y-up, centered at solid volume centroid, circumradius 1

designRule.odd: For s=2m+1: apex + two homothetic m-gon rings + one m-gon cap. F=m+m+1=s.
designRule.evenExcept24: For s=2m+2: three homothetic m-gon rings + two m-gon caps. F=2m+2=s.
designRule.d24: Exact deltoidal icositetrahedron, dual of the rhombicuboctahedron.
